title: Paper record
description: One file per paper: data/papers/<id>.yaml. Label and metadata values are checked against data/vocab.yaml by scripts/validate.py. See schema/README.md.

id.description: Stable internal primary key; equals the file name without .yaml. Never changes after creation.

name.description: Method name as written in Table 1 (or Table 2 for records outside Table 1).

aliases.description: Other names of the same paper, e.g. names before a rename.

psb_kind.description: Only for paradigm-system-benchmark records: baseline (TIGER), paradigm (replaces all five stages at once), framework (open-source framework, benchmark or analysis paper).

domain.description: Application domain from data/vocab.yaml [domain] (e.g. general, poi, ads, cross-domain, multi-domain).

summary.description: Concise 1-sentence English summary of the paper's core mechanism and contribution for Awesome README and paper pages.

rationale_zh.description: Canonical Chinese rationale for Problem × Stage assignment from Table 1 appendix.

problem_claim.description: Structured claim for the problem synthesis row (subproblem, mechanism, claim_kind, grade, evidence_ids, metric_ids).

citation.description: Short citation exactly as shown in Table 1, e.g. 'Wang et al., 2024a'.

survey.description: Presence in the original survey (ARR 2739): table1 = in its Table 1; text = cited in its text only (★‡); none = not in the survey (★).

in_repo_cards.description: Has a card in this repository's papers/ (commit 705a11e).

in_table1.description: Appears as a row of the current Table 1.

external.description: External identifiers and links. None of them is a primary key.

pdf_version.description: Pinned arXiv or PDF version, e.g. '2508.14646v1'.

venue.description: Venue as written in Table 1, track suffix included, e.g. 'KDD’26 ADS'.

code.description: Pinned code repository metadata for code walkthroughs.

training_change.description: Required when labels.stage.value is Training: which split column the change is in (the bold cell in Table 1).

settings.description: Names of the A / B settings when the paper runs two setups; list-valued labels follow this order.

legacy_training.description: Pre-10-26 single Training value from Table 2, kept verbatim while tokenizer/objective are pending.

value.description: A vocabulary value, or a list of them (one per setting) for A / B rows.

inferred.description: Shown as † in Table 1: the paper does not state the value directly. A list marks each setting separately.

source.description: Location in the paper (section, figure, equation, page) or code; 'missing' when none is recorded.

status.description: verified: the source directly supports the value and was checked against the paper; migrated: imported from Table 1 / Table 2 source appendices; inferred values are never verified.

evidence.description: List of evidence IDs in data/evidence.json that directly anchor this label value.

pdf_version.description: Pinned PDF/HTML version checked for this label.
